# Trove — detailed AI reference

## Identity

Trove — Debrid Library. Multi-provider debrid Android app, TorBox
first. Package `app.trove.debrid`, store title "Trove – Debrid
Library". Version 0.1.18, versionCode 18 (2026-11-18). Repository bitmere/trove, main branch. CI on push to main + PRs
(`testDebugUnitTest`, `:core:test`, lint, assembleDebug).

## Stack

Gradle 8.13, AGP 8.13.2, Kotlin 2.2.20, compileSdk 36, minSdk 26,
targetSdk 34. Compose BOM 2026.03.00 (UI 1.10.5), navigation-compose
2.9.8. OkHttp + Gson in :core. EncryptedSharedPreferences
(security-crypto 1.1.0-alpha07, deprecated upstream) for the TorBox
key. No DI framework, no Classic Views, no analytics/ads/trackers.
Manifest requests only INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE. Only network
destination is https://api.torbox.app/v1/api.

## Module map

- :core (Android-free): `DebridProvider` (interface), `TorBoxProvider`
  (mylist x3 kinds, synchronous torrent creation, async web/Usenet creates,
  checkcached, hosters, per-file requestdl, user/me, delete; token-bucket ~5 req/s +
  50/25-per-hour create budgets; 401 to AuthInvalid, 429 to
  RateLimited), `OkHttpTransport` (IO dispatcher, cancellable),
  `RateLimiter`, `ShareClassifier` (magnet to torrent, .torrent to
  torrent, .nzb to Usenet, other link to web), `Models`, `DebridError`.
- :app: `MainActivity` (NavHost downloads/settings, share target),
  `AppContainer` (hand wiring), `DebridRepository` (validate + save
  key, main-safe, Result boundary), `KeystoreCredentialStore`,
  Downloads screen + ViewModel, Add sheet + ViewModel, Settings
  screen + ViewModel, `Glass` (floating action cluster), `BackdropCapture`
  (bounded snapshot blur), `Theme`.

## Design (current)

2026 modern Material 3 UI (shipped in 0.1.5). One primary destination (Downloads). No bottom nav.
mockup-v6.html is a historical design reference only, superseded 2026-11-15.
Torrents/Web/Usenet as top subtabs. Search field at top of list.
Floating liquid-glass action cluster (Add + Search) bottom-right.
Settings behind the avatar. Play via ACTION_VIEW chooser with a concrete video MIME derived from the filename.
Play resolves a per-file TorBox requestdl link for the selected kind and real
file ID. This bearer link goes only to the chosen player, never logs, share
targets or error messages. createstream/getstreamdata are plan-restricted on
Essential and unused.
Share target auto-detects the link kind.

## History

- 0.1.0 (2026-11-15): first build. 37 tests, lint 0 errors. Release
  Historical debug-signed build; current signing is Actions-only.
- 0.1.1 (2026-11-15): fixed Test & Save crash (main-thread network +
  broken Result boundary), Settings back navigation (NavHost,
  predictive back, no unconditional refresh), true backdrop blur
  (bounded snapshot, API 31+/non-low-RAM, scrim fallback). 50 tests,
  lint 0 errors (historical baseline).
- History note (2026-11-16): the 0.1.1 Play, card alignment and stale
  backdrop issues were fixed in 0.1.2/0.1.3. The later blank-screen saga
  was resolved in 0.1.13, confirmed on device on 2026-11-16.
- 0.1.14 baseline: 107 JVM tests, lint 0 errors. T1 changed CI and
  signing without a version bump. Signing is secrets-only in GitHub
  Actions; local release builds cannot sign. The manual updater uses
  https://github.com/bitmere/trove/releases with Stable as the default and
  Beta as an opt-in. The signing key change requires a clean install from
  older signatures and clears local settings and the saved API key.

## Rules that have bitten before

- Compose UI 1.10.5: `GraphicsLayer` is in
  `androidx.compose.ui.graphics.layer`, `drawLayer` likewise;
  `rememberGraphicsLayer` is in `androidx.compose.ui.graphics`;
  `positionInRoot()` was removed, use `localToRoot(Offset.Zero)`;
  `drawContent()` lives on `ContentDrawScope`, not `DrawScope` — inside
  `layer.record { }` use the labelled receiver
  `this@drawWithContent.drawContent()`.
- `kotlinx.coroutines.Job` has `invokeOnCompletion`, not
  `invokeOnCancellation`. Coroutine thread names get " @coroutine#N"
  appended.
- Haze 2.1.0 is incompatible (needs minCompileSdk 37; Trove is 36).
- The repo's gradle.properties must never contain the VM proxy lines;
  the proxy lives only in ~/.gradle/gradle.properties. CI fails on
  `hatch-egress-proxy` if the lines leak in.
- Preserve the Gradle wrapper executable bit. For T2 leave an uncommitted
  diff; no branch, commit, push, tag, release or version change.
- Working docs (fix plans, briefs) stay local and are never pushed.
